newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam sees $50,000 Q4 charge for recall.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam sees $50,000 Q4 charge for recall.

text.p: Sunbeam Corp will take a one-time charge of about $50,000 to its fourth-quarter earnings to cover the recall of 12,000 of its Auto Throws electric blanket, the firm announced Friday.
The company said Friday it would recall 12,000 Auto Throws because of a wiring defect that causes them to catch fire under certain conditions.

Auto Throws are electric blankets that plug into the cigarette lighters of cars or trucks. The company said it is recalling Throws made in 1995 and 1996 with either a 'J' or 'I' before the printed numbers on their product labels.
The company said it stopped making the Throws in October 1996, and has received no reports of injuries stemming from the Throws.
It did, however, receive two property claims for less than $800 each, Sunbeam said.

The $50,000 charge will be in addition to a $300 million restructuring charge to cut 6,000 jobs and eliminate 87 percent of its product lines that Sunbeam announced earlier this month. The company did not say when it would take the $300 million charge -- $75 million of which will be in cash.
